catalog.sub: Products and services the bot can find and offer. After every change the item is re-indexed in the background.
catalog.title: Title
catalog.external_id_hint: Your own ID of the item (SKU, CRM id). Import updates items by it.
catalog.description_hint: The bot answers from this text: what it is, who it suits, what is included.
catalog.attributes_hint: One per line: name: value. Several values — separated by ;. Names: latin letters, digits, _.
catalog.import_hint:
CSV with a header row or JSON (a list of items with the same fields). Items with a known ID are updated, new ones are added. One bad row — nothing is saved.
CSV columns: external_id, title, description, category, price, currency, url, image_url, language, is_active, and attr:name for characteristics (several values separated by a vertical bar).
catalog.deactivate_missing: Switch off items that are not in this import
catalog.import_done: Done: {created} added, {updated} changed, {unchanged} unchanged, {deactivated} switched off.
catalog.import_bad_json: The text is not valid JSON
catalog.remove_confirm: Delete “{name}”? The bot will stop offering it.

knowledge.sub: Texts about the company: terms, delivery, payment, address, rules. The bot answers questions from them.
knowledge.title: Title
knowledge.url_hint: The bot may give this link to the client.
knowledge.body_hint: {n} characters. Long texts are split into pieces; the bot gets only the pieces that fit the question. Separate topics with empty lines.
knowledge.remove_confirm: Delete “{name}”? The bot will stop using this text.

search.knowledge_needs_vectors: The knowledge base needs meaning search: set QDRANT_URL on the server and assign a model to the “embed” role.
search.catalog_needs_index: No search index is on: set ELASTICSEARCH_URL or QDRANT_URL on the server. Until then the bot cannot find catalog items.
search.other_model: {n} indexed with another embedding model. Re-index everything so meaning search finds them.
search.test_hint: Write a question the way the bot sees it after rewriting: complete, in a language of the bot. Green rows are what the bot would use in its answer.
